statement: The proportion of SUID cases with previous child deaths will show trends over time that can be compared to trends in infant care arrangements among live births.
rationale: This study design compares proportions within case series and population reference data, focusing on trends from 2008-2019 for SUID cases and 2012-2015 for infant care arrangements. The sources provide necessary variables to measure previous child deaths and infant care arrangements.
prior_art: The closest related claims discuss trends in SUID incidence but do not address the specific comparison between previous child deaths and infant care arrangements, leaving this gap unexplored (SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C6, bedsharing_ms_v7.C7).
cannot_establish: The design cannot estimate incidence or establish causation; it can only compare trends in proportions among cases.
